# New UI Package Installer **A redesigned package installer for any ROM.** [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Mods-Center/Package-Installer?style=for-the-badge&label=release&color=0a84ff)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Package-Installer/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Mods-Center/Package-Installer/total?style=for-the-badge&color=30d158)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Package-Installer/releases) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Mods-Center/Package-Installer?style=for-the-badge&color=ffd60a)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Package-Installer/stargazers) [![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-channel-26A5E4?style=for-the-badge&logo=telegram&logoColor=white)](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs)
## Features - New UI with animations and Monet (Material You) colours - Drag the top pill to expand a detailed view of the app being installed - Install `.apks` and `.apkm` bundles - Button that opens the app info page - Apps that update themselves work - No Unknown Sources permission or Mi account login needed - Android 17 supported ## Requirements - Android (AOSP, HyperOS, ColorOS and other OEM ROMs) - Magisk, KernelSU or APatch ## Installation 1. Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Package-Installer/releases/latest). 2. Flash it in Magisk, KernelSU or APatch. 3. Reboot your device. ---

New UI Package Installer

A redesigned package installer for any ROM.

![Release](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Package-Installer/releases/latest)

![Downloads](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Package-Installer/releases)

![Stars](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Package-Installer/stargazers)

![Telegram](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs)

Features

  • New UI with animations and Monet (Material You) colours
  • Drag the top pill to expand a detailed view of the app being installed
  • Install `.apks` and `.apkm` bundles
  • Button that opens the app info page
  • Apps that update themselves work
  • No Unknown Sources permission or Mi account login needed
  • Android 17 supported

    • Requirements

  • Android (AOSP, HyperOS, ColorOS and other OEM ROMs)
  • Magisk, KernelSU or APatch

    • Installation

  • Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Package-Installer/releases/latest).
  • Flash it in Magisk, KernelSU or APatch.
  • Reboot your device.
